contact.contact_note: Office/JA shared phone; no separate personal judicial email or fax established. Profile and communications section supply assistant email; inconsistent spellings elsewhere preserved in conflicts.

chambers_communications.summary: Email JA; subject includes case number, case name and matter. Copy all parties unless legally authorized exception; no direct merits communications to judge.

hearing_scheduling.summary: File motion before online calendar booking. Email JA for more than30minutes. UMC non-evidentiary5–10minutes; special-set Zoom for longer non-evidentiary matters; special-set in person for evidentiary matters. Notice at least5business days unless parties agree otherwise. Do not reserve multiple slots; cancel online before2pm preceding business day and separately file/email cancellation notice.

conferral_and_motions.summary: Guide invokes Rule1.202 conferral/certificate and discovery good-faith certification. No piggyback motions without all-party agreement and timely materials. Certain dismissal/more-definite-statement motions are initially reviewed on papers; rehearing/reconsideration requires court permission before setting.

proposed_orders.summary: Email Word orders with parties copied; PDF other materials. Guide requires hearing materials5business days before hearing. When asked to prepare an order after hearing, circulate within2business days and submit within7days, identifying objections; printed post-hearing email differs (conflict retained). Include descriptive caption, hearing date and full case number.

courtesy_copies.summary: All hearing materials by email attachment at least5business days before hearing; no file-sharing links. Word orders and PDF other materials.

remote_appearances.summary: Non-evidentiary matters on Zoom docket; meeting6168154963 included on notice. Guide cites Rule2.530 and requires testifying participants audio/video unless accompanied by notary. Evidentiary special-set docket described as in person; no independent authorization inferred.

emergency_requests.summary: E-file motion explaining emergency and email JA immediately; court determines whether expedited hearing warranted and contacts parties; Zoom unless directed otherwise.

exhibits.summary: Basic submission only: email attachments PDF/JPG/PNG/MP4 at least5business days before proceeding; filename party/number/description. Printed exhibit email differs. Clerk premarking at least48hours before proceeding. Detailed trial presentation not analyzed.

case_management_and_referrals.summary: Guide requires agreed case-management plan/order submitted to JA in Word under its cited AO2021-05 route; no filing before judicial signature. Guide names Sean Lewis for discovery referrals under AO2025-06; current roster names Adrienne Fleming, discrepancy preserved. Shared-rule review later uses saved circuit evidence.

foreclosure_submission_route.summary: Residential foreclosure materials to IRCFORECLOSURES@CIRCUIT19.ORG except sale-cancellation and requests exceeding30minutes; separate docket required. Proposed final judgment Word at least10business days before hearing. Claim-specific prerequisites/forms not substantively reviewed.

facts.summary: Civil division uses online scheduling, JA email submissions with all parties copied, Word proposed orders and attachment-only courtesy materials. Guide has distinct hearing types and residential foreclosure channel. Preserve email, timing and referral discrepancies; do not resolve them.

facts.assignment: All Domestic Relations Cases, including Injunctions for Protection; assist Mental Health/Veterans Court and juvenile detention/shelter hearings.

contact.contact_note: Office/assistant shared route. Profile supplies Suite374; guide mailing block omits suite. Email effective January6,2025 per profile; no separate personal judicial address established.

chambers_communications.summary: Email IRCJudge4@circuit19.org, subject case number/name/matter; copy all parties and clearly say so. Use identifiable attachments; reply within original thread for followup, no repeated duplicate emails or direct merits communications to judge.

hearing_scheduling.summary: File motion/petition before scheduling; coordinate with opposing parties. Nonemergency hearings at least5business days ahead. Online UMC5–10minute non-evidentiary matters and appropriate family-motion docket for up to1hour; contact JA for longer matters. Specialty and self-represented routing retained in guide rather than exhaustively analyzed.

motions_and_conferral.summary: Basic scheduling requires good-faith resolution efforts and notice certification; do not place injunction proceedings on online calendar. No substantive family-motion analysis.

proposed_orders.summary: Email Word proposed order plus filed motion/petition PDF; do not submit proposed orders through portal. Full service list required. Prehearing submission at least5business days ahead. Except prehearing proposals, certify agreement or identify disagreement; follow court-set posthearing deadline and identify objections.

courtesy_copies.summary: Email electronic courtesy copies relied on at hearing; share with opposing party. Word orders, PDF other material, pertinent portions highlighted. Courtesy section says5days; hearing packet/order sections say5business days, retained separately.

remote_appearances.summary: UMC, CMC, uncontested final and non-evidentiary hearings30minutes or less via Zoom unless directed otherwise; ID5230674356, audio/video to testify. Trials/evidentiary/injunction proceedings and hearings over30minutes in Courtroom8 unless directed otherwise; requests cite Rule2.530.

emergency_routing.summary: File detailed emergency motion; email with proposed Emergency Handling Order, EMERGENCY in subject plus case identifiers; court reviews and schedules if appropriate. Merits and specialty prerequisites not analyzed.

noncivil_substantive_procedures.summary: Outside commercial civil focus: family merits, final-judgment checklists, mediation/program detail, trial evidence and specialty forms retained as official links only.
